conditions: This is the abstract String type length in §6.1.4.
limitations: An element count is distinct from Unicode code point count and grapheme count. The type permits sequences that are ill-formed UTF-16.

triggers: Controlling edition correction, applicability change, or material counterexample.

statement: The length of an ECMAScript 2024 String value is the count of its 16-bit elements, which are treated as UTF-16 code units in textual interpretation.
